{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 5 is the 61st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 5th day of Aquarius, and it is a Friday. It corresponds to ISO week 9, weekday 5.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮5日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 61|Chapter 61]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152081}}.
